notes.title: Update! Bomb-Bomb (0.1.1)
notes.content:
This update fixes the bug where the achievement "Start Game" did not unlock even after playing

Thank you very much for your reports and concerns about the bug.
It helped me solve the issue quickly.

If you have any other concerns, please feel free to contact me vitodevs@gmail.com

Thank you again and enjoy the game.

notes.title: Welcome to Bomb-Bomb (0.1.0)
notes.content:
This is a Bomberman inspired game made into 3D with split screen

I always enjoyed playing quick short games with my close friends
and wanted to share the experience with the community.

Thank you all for having a look at my game and hope you enjoy :)

**if there are any bugs you found, please send an email to vitodevs@gmail.com
